title: Cover the task-sync hold-back's invalid-overlay fallback with a CLI test where a non-divergent change names a held-back addition
outcome: Cover the task-sync hold-back's invalid-overlay fallback with a CLI test where a non-divergent change names a held-back addition
acceptance: A CLI test reaches the hold-back's trial-overlay fallback on a path where the outcome differs: A holds Child (a pending addition under a claimed Held), A has an unexported edit in Held's component, and B adds task X, unchanged here, with Child as parent or prerequisite. The import refuses with task_sync_divergent_planning, printing the set-aside, not task_sync_invalid_graph, and A's local change is intact
Removing the trial makes that test fail
